name: Dutch Treat
summary: **Dutch Treat** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] most often credited to Jordan of the Islands, a breeder on Vancouver Island, British Columbia, [[country:CA|Canada]]. It is usually described as a cross of [[northern-lights]] and [[haze]]. Some accounts instead trace it to Washington state growers; Amsterdam coffeeshops carried it under the same name by the 1990s.
